title: Alsace entity who said the witness had the time wrong and asked if this was Italy or Germany

tellings.quote: right then he says am I in Italy or Germany witness says you're in alzace

plain: A strange being once appeared to a witness in Alsace, a region of eastern France, told him he had the time wrong, and then asked, "am I in Italy or Germany?" The witness answered that he was in Alsace. The UFO researcher Jacques Vallée tells this on Jesse Michels's show as a case he summarises without naming a source, the kind of odd, confused exchange that would suggest such visitors are not quite at home in our time and place.
